task_instruction: Ornate by intent. It contains one mixed metaphor (a fire that 'drowned' and 'salted fields'). Repair only that so the fire image stays coherent; keep the lyricism.
source_material: The storm came to the cliff the way grief comes to a house — first at the windows, then in the walls — and the light turned and turned against it and was a fire that drowned the dark and salted the fields of the sky.
